title: Ichor Partners with ManpowerGroup
summary: Ichor partners with ManpowerGroup Talent Solutions RPO to scale hiring in Minnesota, Singapore, and Malaysia as semiconductor demand grows.
body_markdown:
FREMONT, Calif. -- Ichor Holdings, Ltd. (NASDAQ: ICHR) today announced a partnership with ManpowerGroup Talent Solutions, a global leader in recruitment process outsourcing (RPO) and workforce solutions, to amplify hiring capabilities across its Minnesota, Singapore, and Malaysian locations as semiconductor demand continues to accelerate.


The partnership will support Ichor's recruitment for critical operations roles, helping scale Ichor’s workforce quickly to meet growing customer demand and support future business growth.


“Following a thorough RFP process, we’re excited to partner with ManpowerGroup to scale our hiring capabilities in Minnesota, Singapore, and Malaysia,” said Andy Edmundson, Director of Talent Acquisition. “Their expertise in building talent pipelines and employer marketing will help us access skilled talent faster and elevate our employer brand in these strategically important markets.”


"In an industry where precision matters, growth depends on having the right people in the right roles at the right time," said Wayne Crowley, Global Delivery Leader, ManpowerGroup Talent Solutions RPO. "With experience supporting talent acquisition across the semiconductor industry, we look forward to helping Ichor attract and engage the talent needed for critical skilled roles, scale its workforce, and meet evolving customer needs."


The partnership comes as Ichor expands its Southeast Asian operations, growing its workforce and production capacity to meet rising industry demand. Ichor Malaysia’s new “Unity” facility expands critical production infrastructure to support long-term business growth in the region, with the team expected to surpass 1,000 direct labor employees.


To support that commitment, Ichor's talent acquisition team is building hiring strategies across Malaysia and Singapore, including participation in job fairs and hiring events, sponsorship of industry activities, and ongoing collaboration with local educational partners.


"In expanding our machining and assembly capabilities in the region, we have created meaningful jobs for the local community. It's a long-term investment in our Asia operations; one we're backing through the partnership with ManpowerGroup to build a sustainable talent pipeline," said Vijay Chinnasami, Asia Executive Director and Senior Vice President of Operations.


About Ichor


Ichor Holdings, Ltd. (NASDAQ: ICHR) is a leader in the design, engineering, and manufacturing of critical fluid delivery subsystems and components for semiconductor capital equipment.
